comment: What counts as an editor module (studio step, ADR-041): a path prefix (ending in /) or an exact path, relative to the repo root, forward slashes. Read by vite.config.ts (Study: these modules have no side effects, so nothing keeps them in the build) and by scripts/check-edition.mjs (Study: none may be in the output; Studio: at least one). Deliberately not listed: src/core/editing/names.ts (which record kinds carry the shared Names type: schema knowledge the inspector reads). src/app/window/drafts-ui.tsx IS listed (H2): the Study-safe parts read it only through editors-access.ts, inert in Study. names.ts is read by the inspector only through the host (window.tsx passes namesKinds inside the EDITING guard).
